First Light captures the essence of dawn with a luminous fragrance journey. Top notes of raspberry, pear, bergamot, and strawberry open with crisp freshness. The heart unfolds with delicate orange blossom, peony, and jasmine, creating an elegant floral core. Base notes of warm amber, sensual musk, and earthy patchouli provide a grounding finish that lingers beautifully. A sophisticated 100ml fragrance for those who embrace elegance from sunrise to dusk.

Experience the luxurious blend of Touch Of Gold. This 100ml fragrance opens with bright citrus notes—mandarin, orange blossom, and bergamot—creating an inviting first impression. The heart reveals a delicate floral bouquet of jasmine, white flowers, and tuberose, adding elegance and depth. The base settles into warm, sensual notes of musk, vanilla, and sandalwood, leaving a lasting impression throughout the day.

Triumph captures elegance in a 100ml bottle. The fragrance opens with vibrant top notes of plum, pineapple, bergamot, and lime, creating a fresh, fruity introduction. The heart reveals a sophisticated floral blend of rose, jasmine, and origanum, adding depth and romance. The base grounds the composition with warm amber, musk, cedarwood, and sandalwood, leaving a lasting, sensual trail. Perfect for those who appreciate a well-balanced fragrance that transitions beautifully from day to evening.

Maverick captures the essence of bold sophistication in a 100ml bottle. The composition opens with a vibrant burst of apple, pepper, and citrus notes, creating an immediate sense of energy and freshness. The heart reveals a warm, woody character through sandalwood, cedarwood, and guaiacwood, grounding the fragrance with elegance and depth. As the scent settles, vanilla and amber notes emerge in the base, delivering a creamy, sophisticated finish that lingers throughout the day.

True Essence captures the perfect balance of nature's most luxurious scents. Open with vibrant top notes of orange, red fruits, and peach, softened by touches of ivy green. The heart blooms with violet, jasmine, lily, and rose—a floral symphony that unfolds gracefully. As the day progresses, base notes of plum, musk, cedarwood, and sandalwood create a warm, lasting finish that lingers on the skin.

Milestone captures a luminous journey through citrus and florals, settling into a warm embrace. Fresh pear and bergamot open with a bright burst of tangerine, while jasmine and orange blossom create an elegant floral heart. Neroli adds a delicate sophistication before amber, musk, vanilla, and benzoin blend into a soft, lingering base. A refined fragrance for those who appreciate complexity and grace in every spritz.

Aspire unveils a vibrant fragrance journey with a bold top note of grapefruit, pineapple, pink pepper, lemon, bergamot, and black currant. The heart unfolds with warm spices—cinnamon, cardamom, and ginger—creating depth and intrigue. A sophisticated base of vetiver and patchouli grounds the composition, delivering lasting elegance. This 100ml bottle captures the essence of refinement for those who appreciate complexity and character in their signature scent.

Unveil your inner vision with this sophisticated fragrance composition. The invigorating top notes of orange, sea salt, and mandarin create an instant burst of freshness, while the heart reveals a complex blend of pepper, neroli, and cade wood for depth and character. As the scent evolves, a luxurious base of vanilla, musk, amber, vetiver, and resin settles into a warm, sensual finish that lingers throughout the day. A 100ml bottle of refined elegance for those who embrace complexity and distinction.

Spray lightly on pulse points — wrists, neck, and behind the ears — for a long-lasting scent trail.

How to Use: Step 1: Mix your color. Put on your gloves to start. Once your hands are protected, break off the tip of the developer creme, remove the applicator cap, and pierce the opening of the color creme tube using the top. Squeeze the entire tube of color into the developer creme bottle and put the cap back on. Once the cap is firmly secured, place a gloved finger over the cap and shake until everything is perfectly blended together. Step 2: Protect your clothes. Before applying any hair color, it’s a good idea to drape an old towel that you don’t mind getting stained over your shoulders to protect your clothes. Step 3: Detangle your hair. There’s one more step before hair color application. Once all little knots and tangles are set free, you’re ready to begin using Excellence Creme. Step 4: Prep your hair with pre-color serum. Before color comes the pre-color hair serum. While it may seem unnecessary, there’s a reason why this product is included in your little kit. The formula can help protect fragile ends and ensure an even application. All you have to do is massage the serum into your ends, wait two minutes, and move on to the next step without rinsing. Step 5: Begin applying color. Use the tip of your Color bottle to make quarter inch partings from your hairline back towards the crown of your head. Apply the formula to your roots and use a gloved hand to massage it in for full coverage. If your hands don’t seem to be working as well as you’d like, you can also use the included comb for easier application. The key is to make sure that your roots are fully saturated before working your way down toward the ends of your hair. Step 6: Let your hair color process. Once your roots are fully covered, let the creme sit on your hair for 20 minutes. If you have resistant grays, you can allow the mixture to stay on your hair for an additional 10 minutes. After 10-20 minutes, apply the rest of the color to your hair to refresh your overall hair color and add shine. When your hair is completely covered, pull it away from your face and allow color to develop for 10 minutes. Your total developing time should be 30-40 minutes. Step 7: Rinse and style with care. When the time is up, rinse hair with lukewarm water until the water runs clear. Then apply the protective conditioning treatment. It will help keep your color looking and feeling radiant, soft, and silky. Leave the conditioner on for 1-2 minutes before rinsing. Now you’re ready to show it off! Make sure to keep a box of Excellence Creme on hand so that you’re ready for touchups. products.description: LOreal Paris Excellence Creme Hair Colour is a triple care colour with triple care formula. • 100 percent grey coverage from root to tips. Stronger hair, 85 percent more resistant to brushing. • For a beautifully blended colour that complements your look, without a grey in sight. • Rich, even, long lasting hair colour with a soft and silky touch. • Excellence Creme hair colour triple protection means three ways to care for your hair: ceramide protects, pro-keratin strengthens & collagen replenishes. In this pack you will find: the protective serum, colouring creme and developer and conditioner. • 100% resistant grey coverage. • Clean and easy preparation and application. • Rich, radiant, gorgeous colour all with Excellence exclusive non-drip crème. • Nourishing hair colour. How to Use: Step 1: Mix your color. Put on your gloves to start. Once your hands are protected, break off the tip of the developer creme, remove the applicator cap, and pierce the opening of the color creme tube using the top. Squeeze the entire tube of color into the developer creme bottle and put the cap back on. Once the cap is firmly secured, place a gloved finger over the cap and shake until everything is perfectly blended together. Step 2: Protect your clothes. Before applying any hair color, it’s a good idea to drape an old towel that you don’t mind getting stained over your shoulders to protect your clothes. Step 3: Detangle your hair. There’s one more step before hair color application. Once all little knots and tangles are set free, you’re ready to begin using Excellence Creme. Step 4: Prep your hair with pre-color serum. Before color comes the pre-color hair serum. While it may seem unnecessary, there’s a reason why this product is included in your little kit. The formula can help protect fragile ends and ensure an even application. All you have to do is massage the serum into your ends, wait two minutes, and move on to the next step without rinsing. Step 5: Begin applying color. Use the tip of your Color bottle to make quarter inch partings from your hairline back towards the crown of your head. Apply the formula to your roots and use a gloved hand to massage it in for full coverage. If your hands don’t seem to be working as well as you’d like, you can also use the included comb for easier application. The key is to make sure that your roots are fully saturated before working your way down toward the ends of your hair. Step 6: Let your hair color process. Once your roots are fully covered, let the creme sit on your hair for 20 minutes. If you have resistant grays, you can allow the mixture to stay on your hair for an additional 10 minutes. After 10-20 minutes, apply the rest of the color to your hair to refresh your overall hair color and add shine. When your hair is completely covered, pull it away from your face and allow color to develop for 10 minutes. Your total developing time should be 30-40 minutes. Step 7: Rinse and style with care. When the time is up, rinse hair with lukewarm water until the water runs clear. Then apply the protective conditioning treatment. It will help keep your color looking and feeling radiant, soft, and silky. Leave the conditioner on for 1-2 minutes before rinsing. Now you’re ready to show it off! Make sure to keep a box of Excellence Creme on hand so that you’re ready for touchups.
